description: The configuration staged for the next LoCoMo run. It is held until the engine carrying the supersede-downgrade port is pinned; reproduce.py refuses a held config.

engine.note: Set to the head of the supersede-downgrade port once its pull request is up.

dataset.name: LoCoMo (locomo10.json)
dataset.question_id_scheme: {sample_id}:q{j}, j the 0-based index into that conversation's qa list

run.runs_note: Three independent runs of the whole pipeline, ingest included, each over all ten conversations: 1,986 questions, 1,540 of them non-adversarial. Reported as the mean and standard deviation across runs beside each run's own figure.
run.k_note: k=25 is the engine's result cap. It is an owner decision recorded on 2026-09-19, not the output of the pre-registered rule, which selected 20: evidence recall on the fullrun-conv-20260916 store was 68.3% at 20 and 69.2% at 25.

models.route_note: At this engine commit the harness reaches the models through the Claude Code CLI. An OpenAI-compatible route for the same model ids is in review as engraphy PR #8; once it lands, the engine pin moves to a commit carrying it and reproduce.py gains --route openai.

thresholds_resolved.note: Read back at runtime from the pinned engine on the onnx-fp32 profile. Recorded here so a change in any of them is a visible diff to this file.

strict.note: The primary figure: the reader may decline, the judge requires every gold item, best of 3.

reference.note: A second figure beside the strict one, for comparability: the reference answer prompt and judge, categories 1 to 4, one judge pass.

hold: awaiting the engine branch that ports the supersede downgrade (a cross-type supersede, and a supersede whose replacement bands against a third memory, written as a plain memory with the downgrade flagged). Pin its head commit here and remove this field to run.
